name: jacquardlabs-marketplace
description: Jacquard Labs skill plugins for Claude Code — independent judges, aggressive simplification, markdown review, and voice workflows.

plugins.name: viva
plugins.description: Section-by-section markdown review for Claude Code. Claude presents its work, you drill every section, Claude defends and revises — the document only passes when it all holds up.

plugins.name: voice-suite
plugins.description: Voice workflows for Claude Code — 7 skills that mine your writing for a voice profile, then generate docs, emails, chat messages, and rewrites in your voice.

plugins.name: gauntlet
plugins.description: Independent judges for pre-delivery artifacts. Run a changeset or PR through the gauntlet: each lane grades it against a standard it owns and returns findings with anchors and grounds — never a verdict, never a fix.

plugins.name: exorcist
plugins.description: Aggressive simplification for LLM-generated code. A standing ward imported via CLAUDE.md, a changeset pass that traces every hunk to the stated intent and reverts what does not belong, and a read-only codebase séance that hunts pattern contention, dead code, duplicated helpers, and wrapper strata with static-analysis receipts into a register you approve before anything is applied. Scored in concepts removed, never lines.
